messages.subject: Startup message
parts:
Hi guys,

I have a shiny app/websites that loads a couple of files. Trouble is, some of the files are relatively big, so some users are getting impatient and are wondering whether "this thingy is working at all". So, I thought that to let them know what is going on behind the scenes, I'll display some sort of a startup message.

Is there any "best practice" how to do this? I thought either of a progress message ("Loading file xxx"), or maybe even a progress bar...

Any ideas would be appreciated!

Thanks, Philipp
